Generated by tools/build_shorthand.py from translations/*.th.json. Each cluster or phrase entry is expanded from a single byte; adding or removing one changes every encoded string, so rebuild the ROM after regenerating. Four clusters were given back by hand when the weapon attribute badges ///

took four spacing codes. Shorthand gives way before a phrase does -- the phrase codes are laid last and assign() drops them silently, so the four have to come from here. วู, ก์, ฮั and ช์ are the four cheapest the spirit help can spare: those records are packed to zero slack, and every cluster the one full record uses is untouchable however rare it is elsewhere. Together they cost about 90 bytes.
